description: Two sawtooth oscillators, each with two sub oscillators dividing its frequency by a whole number, and one summed output

params.text: Sets the level of the summed output
Sets that oscillator's pitch in semitones, four and a half octaves either way
Shifts that oscillator in octaves, three down to two up
Divides the oscillator's frequency by a whole number from 1 to 15 to give that sub its pitch
Sets the level of that sawtooth, at its own output and in the sum
Sets the level of that sub, at its own output and in the sum

inputs.text: Sets that oscillator's pitch, a volt to the octave, added to its tuning knobs
Adds to the division of that sub, a volt to each step, and the result is held between 1 and 15

outputs.text: All six sawtooths mixed, each voice clamped between -5V and 5V before the volume knob
That oscillator's sawtooth on its own, at the level its trimmer sets
That sub's sawtooth on its own, at the level its trimmer sets

notes: every level trimmer and the volume knob start at zero, so a new module is silent; raise a voice trimmer and the volume knob to hear it
